subject: Mathematics
title: Solving Systems of Equations with LU Decomposition
description: This set of notes explains how LU decomposition records Gaussian elimination and uses forward and backward substitution to solve systems of linear equations.
objectives: Understand how a coefficient matrix is factored into lower and upper triangular matrices
Connect the entries of the lower triangular matrix to Gaussian elimination multipliers
Solve linear systems using forward and backward substitution
Explain why LU decomposition is efficient for repeated systems
Understand the roles of pivoting, singularity, sparsity, and numerical accuracy
prerequisites: Basic understanding of systems of linear equations
